==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''KU-Ponder:''' Ku ku ku. I see... That must be the principle.
:'''KU-Ponder:''' The crystal detached from her form, as the Black Shores' Remnants filled the fissure.
:'''KU-Ponder:''' Just like the Nova... Ku ku ku.
:'''KU-Ponder:''' Energy is merely the vessel for personalities and memories, not their origin--
:'''KU-Ponder:''' Ku ku ku, it functions as the Ship of Theseus, adrift on the tides of eternity.
:'''KU-Ponder:''' How magnificent. I'll come to understand all of it... Ku ku ku.
{{Dialogue End}}
